description: A resource manifest applied to an Airdress operator.

namespace.description: Accepted for k8s familiarity but ignored — every operator manages one airdress's resources (one namespace).

resourceVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token. When present, apply is rejected with 409 if the stored row's `resource_version` doesn't match. When absent, last-writer-wins.

spec.description: A person's own machine, running `airdress shell host`, reachable from that person's enrolled devices. What it may run is defined on the machine itself and reported in status; nothing here can name a program.

enabled.description: When false every leg is closed and opens are refused. Sessions on the machine keep running. Default true.

limits.description: Per-host limits, within the operator's `[shells]` ceilings.

maxViewers.description: Devices attached to one session at once, the typist included.

opensPerMinute.description: Opens a minute, per person, on this host.

machine.description: The id of the approved machine (purpose shell-host). One ShellHost per machine. Immutable.

principal.description: The principal id of the person whose host this is: whoever approved the machine. Only that person may open, watch or type into its sessions. Immutable.

title: Airdress operator ShellHost manifest
